stories.title: Graziano's bold-but-realistic predictions for all 32 NFL teams: Don't be surprised if ...
stories.summary: Jameson Williams leading the Lions' receivers? Xavier Worthy breaking out? Travis Hunter almost entirely at CB? We have 32 outside-the-box things to watch.

stories.title: Tiger's license suspended 5 years after plea deal
stories.summary: Tiger Woods had his driver's license suspended five years Wednesday after striking a plea deal in his DUI case.

stories.title: Source: Vet Van Noy secures deal with Vikings
stories.summary: The Vikings have signed 13-year veteran outside linebacker Kyle Van Noy to their practice squad.

stories.title: Sources: 49ers Kittle, Bosa make trip to Australia
stories.summary: 49ers tight end George Kittle and defensive end Nick Bosa will both make Wednesday's trip to Australia to play the Rams, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

stories.title: Sources: Balogun late U-turn ended Everton move
stories.summary: Folarin Balogun's £40 million ($54m) move from Monaco to Everton collapsed after the USMNT forward pulled the plug on the deal after the transfer deadline, sources told ESPN.
